title: One-Click Counter and Comparison Tool
boundary: Deliver a one-click counter/comparison tool, but only after the counted object, compared entities, input source, comparison rule, output shape, and target environment are defined.
acceptance: Not yet determinable from the public listing because the only functional statement is “I need counter/comparison in one click.”
result: BLOCKED — insufficient public specification to construct a falsifiable implementation without inventing the referent.
next_movement: Ask the client what is being counted, what is being compared, where inputs come from, what one click should trigger, and what exact output counts as correct.
notes: Do not infer a comparison domain from the skill tags alone.
